item.title: 14-year-old snowmobile operator dies in two-vehicle collision in Oxford County
item.description: Oxford County OPP is investigating a Saturday snowmobile collision that claimed the life of a 14-year-old. item.title: Animals perish in Saturday barn fire near Port Dover
item.description: Several animals were killed in a barn fire at a St. John's Road East address in Port Dover on Saturday, Norfolk County fire officials say.

item.title: Would-be robber got more than he 'bargained for', Brantford judge says
item.description: A disguised man who went into the Downtown Pawnbroker shop in October 2024 intending to rob the place was surprised when the owner and customers turned on him.

item.title: Grand Erie school board says its own misstep voids Sloat case
item.description: In the latest court showdown against longtime trustee Carol Ann Sloat, a lawyer for the Grand Erie District School Board argued Friday the case was moot because the board itself didn’t follow the Education Act.
